parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records resides at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift' in the Wallpaper package, which sits under an Examples/SampleApp path and therefore carries sample-app semantics. Per the restraint rules, any cluster where at least one record is a sample-app file must default to no-action. The other record lives in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift' (DebugPanel package) and is production code, making this a classic mixed cluster. Merging or extracting the type alias would couple production DebugPanel code to sample-app demonstration semantics, which is undesirable.
